inputs.cells: every track x market-side x league that is NOT OFF in the clean-model bars proposal (TP-2026-11-16-..., evidence_2026-11_v5clean.json) and is a MODEL cell. LEAGUE_WIDE cells (source NONE, e.g. Argentina NF BTTS) stay the owner's own list outside the TOP-3 (v6 'Own list', unchanged).

windows.development_note: DEVELOPMENT = rows dated < 2026-04-01 (walk-forward out-of-sample model predictions). The cell's probability source parameters, the R2 calibration slope lam and the per-league T3 thresholds are fitted on these rows ONLY.
windows.holdout_label: descriptive holdout: the 2026-04-01..2026-11-08 outcomes were already read by earlier bars studies / fresh holdouts and by the cell statuses of the clean-model proposal (which used all rows through 2026-11); this is the first ranking of them under the v7 rules, not untouched proof

probability: p_used = the cell's own configured source (config of the proposal cell: RAW / BLEND / SHRINK / LEARNED, odds range) with its parameters fitted by src.bars_opt.study.source_params on the family's development rows only (src.research.top3_tiers.cell_rows)
calibration: R2 of v6 exactly (src.research.top3_ranking._lams on the cell's development rows, >= MIN_OWN_BETS 40 rows, DerSimonian-Laird shrink inside the league, clipped to [0, 1]): p_cal = fair + lam * (p_used - fair); cal_ev = p_cal * odds - 1. A cell without lam has no calibrated value: its rows never enter the pool (missing stays missing, no fallback).
pool: holdout rows of the non-OFF MODEL cells with a two-sided BET-role price, inside the cell's odds range, with cal_ev > 0
gameweek: ISO week (%G-W%V) of the match date, per (track, league)

tiers.order: T1, then T2, then T3, each from the pool minus the earlier picks
tiers.T3_RISKY_VALUE: among pool rows with odds >= the league's odds_min AND cal_ev >= the league's margin: the highest cal_ev. A league without a fitted threshold gets no T3 (no global fallback).
tiers.distinct: the three tips are distinct fixture x market (over/under of one line are one market); one direction (OVER / UNDER) per fixture
tiers.ties: date, then row id, then market-side (stable)
tiers.never_pad: a tier without a candidate stays EMPTY; it is never filled with a no-value bet

t3_thresholds.per_league: fitted per (track, league) on development league-weeks only; never global
t3_thresholds.rule: simulate T1 / T2 / T3 per development league-week for every grid point; keep grid points with >= 40 (MIN_OWN_BETS) development T3 picks; choose the highest development T3 ROI (ties: smaller margin, then lower odds). None kept -> NO threshold for that league.
t3_thresholds.file: output/research/top3_tiers_v7/t3_thresholds.json (committed with its sha256 before the holdout evaluation)

stakes.rule: Show all, stake by proof: STAKE when the tip's cell is PROVEN or PROMISING in the clean-model proposal (PROMISING = the small stake of v5 / config/bankroll_policy.json cell_staking, flat per cell), otherwise PAPER and labelled PAPER
stakes.overrides: the owner's cell_staking.block_overrides (Finland NF Over 3.5 at 0.5%) and the Argentina NF BTTS league rule (0.5%, own list) are unchanged by this protocol

shortfall_diagnostics.unit: every (track, league, ISO week) of the holdout with fewer than 3 tips
shortfall_diagnostics.fixtures: the played matches of the frame (src.retrain_harness.protocol.load_committed_frame), per league and week
shortfall_diagnostics.slots: fixture x non-OFF MODEL cell of the league; each slot: model (a prediction exists), price (a two-sided BET-role price), lam (the cell has a calibration slope), value (cal_ev > 0 in range)
shortfall_diagnostics.causes_precedence: NO_FIXTURES (no played match: international break / off-season) > ALL_CELLS_OFF > the largest blocking slot count among NO_MODEL / NO_PRICE / NO_CALIBRATION / NO_POSITIVE_EV; with >= 3 value slots but T3 empty: T3_NO_THRESHOLD or T3_BAND_EMPTY; otherwise RULE_CONFLICT (distinct / direction)
shortfall_diagnostics.outputs: share of league-weeks with 3 / 2 / 1 / 0 tips per league; cause breakdown; a fix list for every data / collection cause (listed with cost, not built)

evaluation.once: scripts/top3_tiers_v7.py evaluate runs once (marker file); per tier per league: bets, hit rate, ROI with 95% CI (src.bars_opt.study.score: block bootstrap by match date / max-of-three SE), mean odds, CLV where a closing price exists (football-data closing via the certified join, OddsAPI B1 close, own close); then the combined TOP-3 and STAKE vs PAPER
evaluation.comparison: v6 R2 on the same holdout rows: tips clearing the serving cell's bars (source refitted on development rows only), TOP-3 per league-week by R2 (src.research.top3_ranking.select)
evaluation.not_a_test: descriptive only (see windows.holdout_label); no PROVEN claim comes from this evaluation; the owner decides
